messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that falls on a weekday (Monday–Thursday) and is therefore flanked by a Saturday and/or Sunday, giving you a three‑day break.

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Province(s) where it’s a statutory holiday | Long‑weekend span |
|-------------|---------|-------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island | **Feb 18 – 20** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | All provinces & territories | **Apr 7 – 9** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan | **May 20 – 22** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | All provinces & territories | **Sep 2 – 4** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | All provinces & territories | **Oct 7 – 9** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | All provinces & territories | **Nov 9 – 11** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | All provinces & territories | **Dec 23 – 25** (Sat‑Mon) |

### Notes

* **New Year’s Day (Jan 1)** fell on a Sunday, so it didn’t create a long weekend.  
* **Canada Day (Jul 1)** was a Saturday, so it also didn’t create a long weekend.  
* **Boxing Day (Dec 26)** fell on a Tuesday, so it didn’t create a long weekend.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app! If you need the same information for other years or for specific provinces, just let me know.
